name: Create scheduled page test
description: Create scheduled page test Creates a scheduled test for a page. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/schedule/{url}
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/schedule/{url}
Creates a scheduled test for a page.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path)
Optional: region (query); frequency (query) — The frequency of the scheduled test. Defaults to WEEKLY for free plans, DAILY for paid plans.

name: Start page test
description: Start page test Starts a test for a specific webpage, in a specific region. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests
Starts a test for a specific webpage, in a specific region.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Delete scheduled page test
description: Delete scheduled page test Deletes a scheduled test for a page. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/schedule/{url}
context:
DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/schedule/{url}
Deletes a scheduled test for a page.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path)
Optional: region (query)

name: Delete all page tests
description: Delete all page tests Deletes all tests for a specific webpage from a specific region. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests
context:
DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests
Deletes all tests for a specific webpage from a specific region. Deleted tests are still counted as part of the quota.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path)
Optional: region (query)

name: Get quota and availability
description: Get quota and availability Retrieves quota for all plans, as well as the current zone quota. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/availabilities
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/availabilities
Retrieves quota for all plans, as well as the current zone quota.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Get a page test schedule
description: Get a page test schedule Retrieves the test schedule for a page in a specific region. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/schedule/{url}
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/schedule/{url}
Retrieves the test schedule for a page in a specific region.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path)
Optional: region (query)

name: Get a page test result
description: Get a page test result Retrieves the result of a specific test. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests/{test_id}

name: List core web vital metrics trend
description: List core web vital metrics trend Lists the core web vital metrics trend over time for a specific page. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/trend
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/trend
Lists the core web vital metrics trend over time for a specific page.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path); region (query); deviceType (query); start (query); tz (query) — The timezone of the start and end timestamps.; metrics (query) — A comma-separated list of metrics to include in the results.
Optional: end (query)

name: List tested webpages
description: List tested webpages Lists all webpages which have been tested. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages
Lists all webpages which have been tested.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: List page test history
description: List page test history Test history (list of tests) for a specific webpage. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/speed_api/pages/{url}/tests
Test history (list of tests) for a specific webpage.
Required: zone_id (path); url (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); region (query)
